value.rationale: The natural Singer orbit is a structurally motivated subgroup quotient of a canonical incidence graph. Published character data already predicts 4 rational classes, but allows integral 7-torsion and uncertain fundamental/higher homotopy. The new exact quotient classification removes this ambiguity and provides a stable object-level answer, not a duplicate rational Betti count, arbitrary slice or only executable experiment.
